correctness.rationale: The telescoping information identity, strict convexity and monotonicity of g on the relevant eventual/posterior range, Jensen, and the global attracting fixed-cycle argument prove the full claim for all nonnegative precision sequences of positive Cesaro mean, including stable/unstable boundaries. Correct exact stationary root and strict periodic equality were reconstructed. Script check.py passed 7609 independent algebraic and numerical assertions; they support but do not replace infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Full-text comparisons of the two closest recent primary papers establish materially different resource objectives or outcome metrics. A broad prior finite-horizon 1995 optimization is acknowledged as an inaccessible plausible equivalent. Additional searches of mathematical records and published literature revealed no exact infinite-horizon scalar constant-precision optimality and strict periodic equality theorem; search absence alone is not treated as novelty proof. The claim is restricted to the precise new implication, not the standard Riccati/Jensen ingredients.
residual_risks: A previously derived scalar specialization within the 1995 resource-allocation paper may imply all or part of the result; its full text was not accessible.
A related theorem in specialist convex Riccati resource scheduling may exist under alternate terminology; no global literature search can exclude it.
Periodic optimality is specific to the linear mean-precision cost, and does not contradict results for a fixed number of measurements or different sensing costs.

value.rationale: An exact classification of the optimal precision budget over all periods and arbitrary infinite schedules answers a natural and operationally meaningful question about sensing intensity in homogeneous scalar Kalman filtering. It distinguishes divisible precision allocation from discrete measurement scheduling where irregularity may be optimal, and provides a large exact unstable example. No vector, nonlinear-cost or finite-horizon result is claimed.
